newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: BHP says to explore in Guatemala next year.
newsitem.headline: BHP says to explore in Guatemala next year.

text.p: The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd (BHP) (BHP) will begin to prospect for minerals in Guatemala next year, a company spokesman said Monday.
The Energy and Mines Ministry granted three mining concessions to Australian-based BHP in September.

"We won't begin serious work on the concessions until drier weather in January," Philip Pyle, BHP's manager for exploration for the Caribbean region, told Reuters Monday in a telephone interview from Houston.
BHP's interest in the area of the third concession is based on a geological study, said Pyle.
There are no indicators of "economic quantities" of minerals in any of the concessions at this time, according to Pyle.
"This is a very early stage. There are only tentative indications there may be something there," said Pyle.
